verdictProse:
Hostile validation verdict, gate admin-pwa-source-round4, wordpairs source revision f35b696b090985f1119bca5b1f50187997a86113 (staging readiness only). Local timestamp 2026-10-29T09:21:36. Reviewer ClaudeCode, model claude-opus-5-5 (runtime attested); effort high per launch command only (not runtime attested). Session ClaudeCode-20261029T140011Z-plugin-session, request req-20261029T140016Z-prompt-ba89; parent Codex-20261027T100516Z-plugin-session / req-20261029T135928Z-prompt-c0e1; earlier retry turn req-20261029T042903Z-prompt-c233.

OverallVerdict DISAGREE. Accuracy 96. Completeness 94. Both are below 98 and surfaces 1, 2 and 4 each have FAILs. PASS 35, FAIL 5, UNKNOWN 3 of 43.

What holds: HEAD is clean; f35b696 changes no src file after 1c22727. All five JUnit/TRX hashes match the index; unit 587, PostgreSQL 68, browser 78 and planner 6/6 mock and real pass with 0 failed and 0 skipped, 1:1 by name, in a run that started after the commit. The 279-path source manifest equals the committed tree byte for byte. Copy Invitation Link copies inside the user gesture, falls back to writeText, keeps a selectable link with a manual-copy message, and on creation failure or a missing URL shows an error with no link and no success claim. Round3 findings: F-R3-1 is remediated by a catch-up revert, eight-case mock gate with five targeted rejected wrong outcomes, and reapply, followed by the full suite; the original implementation still predates any complete gate, that chronology is unchanged and not excepted, and the receipts say so. F-R3-2 is remediated by a second wrong mock and a per-case rejection check. F-R3-4 is remediated: TR-23-C02 is recorded on the TR and TEST and TR-23 notes name the PowerShell planner. INVITE-COPY-01/02/03 and TR-23-C02 are live, unsatisfied and in the canonical export. Nothing is claimed done or deployed. No credential appears in any tracked file or public copy.

Why DISAGREE:
F-R4-1 (low, test adequacy): the reaction cooldown case failed once and is unexplained; its 1 ms boundary runs on an unpaused Playwright clock against a Date.now-based display clock, so it is timing-dependent by inference. Three focused passes and one full-suite pass do not establish stability or a cause.
F-R4-2 (low): run-phase1.ps1, modified in range and used for the PostgreSQL lane, and three other tests/integration scripts have no analyzer receipt; 19 warnings in 5 scripts are unfixed and unjustified. The broad receipt honestly reports 3 bad files (11 warnings); zero overall is not claimed.
F-R4-3 (low, accuracy): admin_pwa_release.md still says the planner cases preceded the PowerShell implementation, gives 276 instead of 279 paths, and omits round3 and round4 status.
F-R4-4 (low): the request and evidence index lack run id, host and command per TRX (profile 7.9).
F-R4-5 (low): deployment_plan.md:26 and :78 still give current-voice public-PWA and bootstrap instructions.
UNKNOWN: runtime effort; prior failsafe 5ca5 fate; whether the Copy Invitation Link requirement change had a plan and approval before implementation.
The 503 retry cause remains unproven and the reaction cause unexplained; neither is claimed known. I-R4-1 to I-R4-14 are informational.

Not claimed and still pending: migration 012 on staging then production, live GitHub consent, standalone phone OAuth continuity, physical installation, hosted invitation behavior, hosted rollout, production and power-loss durability.
